name: V3 planet-class production remainder carry prepare

tests.name: Set the fixture planet to one worker per commodity and clear prior tick state
Set three workers per unit for Ore, Organics and Equipment

data.sql: UPDATE planet_production SET workers_per_unit=CASE WHEN commodity_code IN ('ORE','ORG','EQU') THEN 3 ELSE 0 END,base_prod_rate=0,base_cons_rate=0 WHERE planet_type_id=(SELECT type FROM planets WHERE planet_id=900);

tests.name: Ensure capacity rows for all three production commodities

data.sql: INSERT INTO planet_goods(planet_id,commodity,quantity,max_capacity,production_rate) VALUES(900,'ORE',0,100000,0),(900,'ORG',0,100000,0),(900,'EQU',0,100000,0) ON CONFLICT(planet_id,commodity) DO UPDATE SET quantity=0,max_capacity=100000;

tests.name: Reset authoritative inventory for all three commodities

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code,quantity) VALUES('planet',900,'ORE',0),('planet',900,'ORG',0),('planet',900,'EQU',0) ON CONFLICT(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=0;
INSERT INTO config(key,value,type) VALUES('test.deterministic_scheduler_enabled','1','int') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value='1',type='int';

tests.name: Schedule only registered planet growth handler for first ten-minute tick

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET enabled=(name='planet_growth'),schedule=CASE WHEN name='planet_growth' THEN 'every:600s' ELSE schedule END,next_due_at=CASE WHEN name='planet_growth' THEN to_timestamp((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)::bigint/600+1)*600) ELSE next_due_at END;
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM next_due_at)::bigint FROM cron_tasks WHERE name='planet_growth';

tests.name: Run first actual planet production tick
First tick carries an independent remainder for every commodity without fractional stock

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.ore_production_remainder=1 AND p.organics_production_remainder=1 AND p.equipment_production_remainder=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=900 AND commodity_code IN ('ORE','ORG','EQU') AND quantity=0)=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p WHERE p.planet_id=900;
